title: FreezeManifest
description: Shipping container written by the freeze step: the dates the demo-wide statement needs on every screen ('produced offline and frozen on ...'), independent of whichever content module a screen loads, and the list of every data module written. It is the only data module loaded at start-up; if it fails, the application shows G-E1 rather than an undated statement. Not rendered as an element of its own. Shipped in data/freeze.js.

pipelineRunOn.description: The date the offline runtime pipeline ran.

modules.description: Every data module the freeze step wrote, as repository-relative paths: top-level modules (data/signals.js and so on), per-trend reveal bundles (data/reveal/<trendId>.js) and per-trend conversation-question modules (data/conversation/<trendId>.js). Lets the M1 tests detect a hand-added or missing module. Whether any conversation module is listed decides whether F5 runs interactively or as the static screen F5-ST (docs/03-architecture.md section 6.4).
